title: Vampire Vape Desserts Raspberry Ripple Ice Cream 10ml  E-Liquid
description: Raspberry Ripple Ice Cream by Vampire Vape Desserts delivers the nostalgic taste of creamy vanilla ice cream swirled with sweet and tangy Raspberry sauce. This dessert-inspired e-liquid blends flavours of smooth, velvety ice cream with a rich, fruity swirl that adds a delightful sweet-tart contrast, reminiscent of the classic summer treat. Formulated for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this e-liquid is available in 0mg, 3mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg freebase nicotine strengths. The 3mg strength features a 50VG/50PG ratio for a balanced experience, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths offer a 40VG/60PG blend to deliver a slightly stronger throat hit and clearer flavour profile. Proudly made in the UK and fully TPD-compliant, Raspberry Ripple Ice Cream is part of the Vampire Vape Desserts range — a flavourful collection of e-liquids inspired by indulgent, familiar favourites. Also available in High-VG Shortfills and DIY Concentrates.
